title: Classical Margin of Safety with Fitting Factor (CS-27.625)
label: CERTIFICATION_SIZING
equation: design_load_n = quantize(applied_load_n * reserve_factor * fitting_factor, 0.001); margin_of_safety = quantize((allowable_load_n / (reserve_factor * fitting_factor * applied_load_n)) - 1, 0.001); reserve_factor_achieved = quantize(allowable_load_n / (fitting_factor * applied_load_n), 0.001); utilization_ratio = quantize((reserve_factor * fitting_factor * applied_load_n) / allowable_load_n, 0.001).
note: CS-27.625 Fitting Factor sizing (FF >= 1.15 on critical fittings unless structural tests substantiate lower strength variance). Assists human engineer review; never determines regulatory compliance.
